notes:
Mid-market product analytics company evaluating Redwood as their primary LLM inference partner. Initial PoC ran on Hosted API (Feb) to validate latency & quality; now progressing to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. POC summary: integrated chat+search pipeline against 18M-doc corpus; evaluated embeddings similarity + reranking stage. Key measured targets: 250 qps embedding throughput during batch jobs, p50 generation latency ~40ms, target p99 <120ms for chat flows under Dedicated. Cost sensitivity: high on per-token unit economics for batch embeddings; open to quantization recommendations from Optimize team.

Procurement/legal path: MSA sent 2026-02-28; legal returned redlines 2026-03-08. Primary redline items: unlimited liability cap carve-outs, IP assignment language for derivative prompts, and governing law. DPA requires explicit EEA data residency and 60-day deletion SLA for customer-controlled vectors. Security review in progress: vendor questionnaire (Vanguard Helix GRC) completed 2026-03-05, waiting on SOC2 attestation details from Redwood and KMS/HSM integration plan.

Commercials: prefer 12-month committed Dedicated pool with burst credits. Pricing discussion: Redwood provided two options (committed capacity with lower megacost vs on-demand hosted). Initial internal estimate ~ $75k-$175k ARR depending on final capacity & SLA credits. Procurement wants line-item for monthly throughput SLA and remedies (service credits).

Customer quotes & signals: "Hosted integration was seamless — latency numbers look promising; Dedicated is next to lock cost predictability." — Head of Platform (call 2026-02-18). They flagged the need for a single-tenant Dedicated option with private peering (VPC) and KMS integration before final sign-off.

Operational notes: SE ran two smoke POCs: one for embeddings batch (success, 95% completion under time budget) and one for low-latency chat (met p50 but p99 needs tuning). Action items: SE to share quantization benchmark, Redwood Optimize to propose caching/batching config, legal to agree on DPA residency text.

Stubs and refs: pricing deck link and security answers in Drive; Fireflies transcripts for demos; Jira RDW-9876 opened for SLA question escalation.
